questions.question: A CI pipeline script runs `claude "Analyze this PR"` and the job hangs indefinitely, with logs showing it's waiting for interactive input. What's the fix?
options: Add the -p flag: claude -p "Analyze this PR"
Add a --batch flag
Set an environment variable like CLAUDE_HEADLESS=true before running the command
Redirect stdin from /dev/null

questions.question: A CI/CD pipeline runs Claude Code to generate tests in one step, then review the same code in a subsequent step, both using -p correctly. The review step rarely finds issues that human reviewers consistently catch. What's the likely cause and fix?
options: The generation and review steps must run as independent sessions with no shared context, so the review instance approaches the code without the original reasoning bias
The review step needs --output-format json to produce structured, parseable findings
The review step is running on a less capable model tier and needs upgrading
The CLAUDE.md file lacks testing standards, so the review step has no criteria to evaluate against

questions.question: A CI/CD pipeline runs three Claude Code steps in sequence (generate changelog, review changelog for accuracy, check for breaking changes) and the review/check steps never catch anything the generation step missed. What's the root cause?
options: The three steps share session context, so steps 2 and 3 inherit step 1's reasoning instead of independently judging the changelog
The steps need --output-format json so each can parse the previous step's structured output
The -p flag isn't being used, causing each step to wait for interactive input
The CLAUDE.md file doesn't contain changelog formatting standards

questions.question: A CI pipeline needs one Claude Code step to output structured JSON for a dashboard, and another step to produce plain text output. How should the two steps be configured?
options: Run the JSON-needing step with -p --output-format json, and the plain-text step with -p alone, as separate non-interactive invocations
Run both steps in a single Claude Code session with -p, using different prompts to request different formats
Run both steps with --output-format json and have the plain-text step extract content from the JSON response
Run both steps with -p and have the dashboard parse plain text output from both

questions.question: What's the rule of thumb for choosing between routines, headless mode, and the Agent SDK?
options: Routines for repeat work you don't want to self-host; headless mode when the job needs your own pipeline; the Agent SDK when the work belongs inside your own product
Always prefer the Agent SDK, since it subsumes both routines and headless mode
Routines and headless mode are interchangeable; the Agent SDK is only for enterprise customers
Headless mode is deprecated in favor of routines for all CI/CD use cases

questions.question: A team wants every PR reviewed automatically with inline comments, nothing custom to build or host, and no need for Claude to approve/block the PR. What's the best fit?
options: Managed Code Review via the Claude GitHub App
The Claude Code GitHub Action with a custom workflow
A routine triggered on every PR open
The Agent SDK embedded in a custom review service
